title: Debugger Walkthrough v1
description: An ordered set of debugger stops the agent authors to walk a human through code: at each stop the live debugger pauses at the named line, the editor reveals it, and the agent narrates what to look at, showing the real paused variable state. Use mode 'review' to showcase finished work and 'blocked' to show exactly where the agent is stuck.

title.description: One line naming what this walkthrough shows.

mode.description: 'review' showcases finished work; 'blocked' walks to where the agent is stuck.

module.description: Python module to run under the debugger (run via -m).

config_name.description: VS Code launch config name to create/use.

line.description: Line to stop at. Provide line OR function/class.

function.description: Function to stop at (resolved to its def line).

class.description: Class to stop at (resolved to its class line).

say.description: What the agent narrates at this stop.

locals.description: Local variable names to read and show.

expect.description: Optional name->repr assertions the eval checks against the captured state.
